newsitem.title: CANADA: Canada dollar ends weaker, quiet overnight seen.
newsitem.headline: Canada dollar ends weaker, quiet overnight seen.

text.p: * Canada's dollar ended weaker in thin trading on Tuesday, closing around C$1.3802 (US$0.7245) from C$1.3785 (US$0.7254) on Friday * Traders expected a quiet overnight session with the currency trading between C$1.3790 and C$1.3820 * Canadian dollar hampered by continued weakness in fixed-income markets, traders said
Traders said soft debt markets continued to weigh on the Canadian dollar on Tuesday.
Canadian bonds closed weaker in active trading, following losses in U.S. treasuries on Monday when Canadian markets were closed for a civic holiday.
Canada's 30-year long bond fell C$0.82 to C$119.08 to yield 6.469 percent.
On the crosses, the Canadian dollar climbed to 86.33 Japanese yen from Monday's close of 85.69 and jumped to 1.3612 marks from Monday's 1.3479 marks.
